semantic_contract.event: runtime unavailable or direct admission rejection before a handle is returned
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: try_spawn returns SpawnError; spawn panics through expect
semantic_contract.must_preserve: fallible and panicking entry points remain distinct

semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: complete_task stores one result; poll takes it once and returns T
semantic_contract.must_preserve: exactly one terminal value is observable

semantic_contract.event: poll before completion then publish completion
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: one equivalent Waker slot is retained or replaced under the mutex and taken before wake outside the mutex
semantic_contract.must_preserve: no lost wake and no callback under the completion mutex

semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: CatchUnwind stores the panic payload and the awaiter resumes that payload
semantic_contract.must_preserve: this family remains panic-based rather than silently converting to typed JoinError

semantic_contract.event: mailbox request is cancelled or denied after try_spawn returned a handle
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: the unadmitted callback stores an error payload that becomes an awaiter panic
semantic_contract.must_preserve: the observer resolves exactly once; no typed-cancellation claim is added to this family

semantic_contract.event: runtime drain resolves a pending request or executor-side completion state disappears
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: runtime drain resolves pending requests; a handle with no result and no executor-side Arc panics when polled
semantic_contract.must_preserve: is_finished becomes true and a subsequent await does not park forever

semantic_contract.event: JoinHandle is dropped before task completion
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: there is no JoinHandle Drop implementation and task execution is not cancelled by observer drop
semantic_contract.must_preserve: a completion transport replacement must not introduce abort-on-handle-drop

semantic_contract.event: terminal query and poll after terminal consumption
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: is_finished checks local completion, stored result, or executor-side disappearance; repoll asserts
semantic_contract.must_preserve: the query remains non-consuming and repoll remains an explicit failure

semantic_contract.event: gateway or region counter is unavailable before publication
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: Cx::spawn and Cx::spawn_in return SpawnError::RuntimeUnavailable and never panic
semantic_contract.must_preserve: no handle is returned for a request that was never published

semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: the completion sender commits Ok(value); join, try_join, or poll_join consumes one terminal result
semantic_contract.must_preserve: the value is delivered once with no ambient cancellation check on the join receive

semantic_contract.event: join or JoinSet scan observes a pending result
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: join owns a temporary uninterruptible waiter; poll_join stores a persistent waiter on Receiver
semantic_contract.must_preserve: pending JoinSet scans retain at least one live wake registration

semantic_contract.event: structured task factory or future panics
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: CatchUnwind converts the message to JoinError::Panicked and the task Outcome is Panicked
semantic_contract.must_preserve: panic stays typed for this family

semantic_contract.event: cancel-before-admission, region close, quota denial, or result-channel closure
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: the completion slot or closed-channel mapping yields JoinError::Cancelled with the strongest available reason
semantic_contract.must_preserve: every accepted request terminates its handle and preserves cancellation attribution

semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: cancellation is requested and strongest reason is cached or published; immediate task termination is not promised
semantic_contract.must_preserve: abort remains reason-strengthening and admission-race safe

semantic_contract.event: JoinFuture is dropped before terminal completion
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: drop requests abort unless defused or the receiver is already terminal
semantic_contract.must_preserve: stop-waiting implies stop-task only for JoinFuture, not for TaskHandle itself

semantic_contract.event: TaskHandle is dropped without constructing a JoinFuture
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: there is no TaskHandle Drop implementation; the region remains the task owner and quiescence backstop
semantic_contract.must_preserve: handle drop alone does not request cancellation

semantic_contract.event: terminal query and consume after a prior terminal consume
semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: is_finished observes ready, closed, or terminal_consumed; later consumption returns JoinError::PolledAfterCompletion
semantic_contract.must_preserve: repoll remains typed and is_finished remains non-consuming

semantic_contract.incumbent_contract: Scope::join_all and JoinSet::join_all return input or spawn order; JoinSet::join_next returns completion order with earliest-spawned ready tie-break
semantic_contract.must_preserve: a batch producer cannot change collection ordering
